newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market light at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market light at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, with steady slaughter steers and heifers, USDA said. Feedlots reported moderate inquiry.
Sales reported on 3,400 head slaughter steers and 700 heifers; 66,000 head confirmed for week to date which includes 14,000 formulated and 2,300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 67.00-67.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00.
Wk to Date - 66,000 Week Ago - 58,100 Year Ago - 10,300
